issue.PROJECT_NAME: Project names may use only lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
issue.NAME_INVALID: Project names may use only lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
issue.NAME_INVALID_withSlug: Project names may use only lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. With the current value it will be created as "{{slug}}".
issue.REQ_SHORT: The requirements are short ({{length}} characters; {{min}} or more recommended). /forge-init will have to ask many questions.
issue.UI_OFF: The UI/UX design stage is not used. System design follows analysis directly.
issue.PATH_OVERLAP: Owned folders overlap: dev-{{devA}} ({{pathA}}) / dev-{{devB}} ({{pathB}}). This causes merge conflicts and hook bypasses.
issue.DEV_DEFERRED: dev-{{dev}}: domain and folders are left empty. /forge-agents will fill them in after analysis.
issue.REVIEW_WEAKER: review-{{dev}} may be a weaker model than dev-{{dev}}. A reviewer should use a model equal to or stronger than the developer's.
issue.IMPORT_UNACKED: {{id}}: the risky items have not been confirmed (Skills step).
issue.DOMAIN: A domain uses only lowercase letters, digits and '-', up to 32 characters.
issue.MODEL_ID: A model ID starts with a letter or digit and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '/', '@' and '-'.
issue.PATH_PREFIX: Write owned folders as paths relative to the repository root (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-', and '/' for subfolders).
issue.PATH_DOT_SEGMENT: Owned folders cannot contain '.' or '..' path segments.
issue.DEV_PARTIAL: dev-{{dev}}: fill in the domain and the owned folders together, or leave both empty.
issue.OPENROUTER_FREE_LIMIT: {{count}} agent(s) use OpenRouter free models and share the account-wide limits of 20 requests per minute and 50 per day (1,000 per day after topping up $10 or more).
issue.GATEWAY_REQUIRED: OpenAI and Gemini go through the LiteLLM gateway. Start scripts/start-gateway.sh before running in parallel.
issue.VLLM_TOOL_PARSER: An internal vLLM must run with --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser for file edits to work.
issue.HTTP_URL: The address is not valid. Use only http(s)://host[:port], without credentials, spaces or quotes.
issue.DEV_COUNT_MISMATCH: The developer count ({{developerCount}}) does not match the developer list ({{devs}}).
issue.DEV_COUNT_OVER_TIER: The current tier allows up to {{tierLimit}} developers.
issue.COMMAND: Enter the command on a single line.
issue.DEVCONTAINER_CLOSED_NET: Dev Container: the image and packages are downloaded in your environment, so network access is required (the app itself calls nothing external). On a closed network, switch to an image from your internal registry.
issue.TMUX_PREFIX: Write the tmux prefix as C-a to C-z (for example C-a).
issue.CLAUDE_MD_MARKERS: The AGENTFORGE:{{id}} markers in the existing CLAUDE.md are unpaired, duplicated or out of order. Fix the markers or clear the box.
issue.IMPORT_NAME_MISMATCH: {{id}}: the name in SKILL.md differs from the skill ID.
issue.SKILL_REF: The source commit must be 7-40 lowercase hex characters.

dev.title: Agents per developer
dev.lead: Each developer gets a dedicated agent (dev-N), a paired reviewer (review-N), a dedicated skill (devN-domain) and an owned-scope file (.claude/devs/dev-N.paths). If you leave the domain and folders empty, /forge-agents creates them from tasks.md after analysis.
dev.note: A hook enforces the owned scope. If Edit or Write touches a file outside it, guard-paths.sh blocks the call (exit 2) and returns the reason to the agent. Changes made around it through Bash are caught again by a git diff scope check before review.

conn.title: Connection and parallel run
conn.lead: AgentForge never accepts keys. Copy the generated .agentforge/env.local.example and fill in your own. Only the default addresses are set here.
conn.claude: Sign in directly (subscription or API key)
conn.note: VS Code: in the integrated terminal (WSL) run Tasks: Run Task, then AF: parallel run. Signal files are collected in .agentforge/signals/ of the main repository, and the watch window delivers messages by tmux pane id.

tmux.title: tmux layout (one window per developer pair)
tmux.watch: Signal watch, scope check, limit of {{max}} rejections

layout.pair: pair: one window per developer pair
layout.role: role: a dev window and a review window

tmux.prefixHint: One of C-a to C-z. Default C-b
tmux.logsHint: When on, output is appended to .agentforge/logs/<agent>.log (excluded by .gitignore).
tmux.unset: If left unset, defaults apply (pair, C-b, mouse off, logs off) and no tmux entry is added to the output.

routine.title: Routine and sequential-stage agents
routine.lead: Boundaries are fixed sequentially up to common development; only after that does work split per developer. Parallel-stage agents are chosen per developer on the Developers screen.

flow.parallel: Parallel, one tmux window per developer

routine.note: A provider is chosen per agent (session). The generated scripts/agent-env.sh picks the address and model by agent name at run time. Claude uses the account you signed in to yourself.

analyst.gate: Every feature ID assigned, zero owned-folder overlap

ux-designer.gate: Screens mapped to features, data needed per screen settled

architect.gate: Contract frozen, screen data to API mapping complete

common-dev.gate: Build and tests pass, develop tagged

integrator.gate: All tests pass plus final human approval

skills.title: Skills
skills.lead: Skills provide knowledge; hooks do the enforcing. Skill folders have no access restriction, so only the ones needed are preloaded through each agent definition's skills: list.
skills.runInUser: Run in your own Claude Code
skills.devDesc: Terms, rules, APIs and test data of the {{domain}} domain

tdd.desc: Tests first, confirm failure, then implement

forge-init.desc: Requirements to PRD and the CLAUDE.md project section

forge-agents.desc: tasks.md to per-developer agents, skills and scope

devcontainer.label: Generate a Dev Container
devcontainer.hint: When on, .devcontainer/devcontainer.json is created. Put env.local in yourself inside the container as well.

doc.label: Paste an existing CLAUDE.md (optional)
doc.hint: If you paste a CLAUDE.md you already use, text outside the markers (AGENTFORGE:…) and the PROJECT section stay as they are, and only the other sections are replaced with the newly generated content. Leave it empty to use the generated file as is.
doc.note: Markers are counted even inside code blocks. The pasted text is not saved and disappears when you close the page.
